title: Integration Patterns, Cost Optimization, KPIs/ROI, and Cloud-First Design
bodyMarkdown:
## Integration patterns and data movement

Decoupling a monolith or connecting systems relies on a handful of patterns:

| Pattern | Service(s) | Use for |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| **Async messaging / event fan-out** | **Pub/Sub** | One event → many consumers; producer/consumer decoupling |
| **Managed ETL / streaming pipelines** | **Dataflow**, **Data Fusion** | Batch + streaming transforms at scale |
| **Workflow orchestration** | **Workflows**, **Cloud Composer (Airflow)** | Coordinating multi-step processes |
| **API exposure / management** | **Apigee**, **API Gateway** | Governed, versioned APIs |
| **CDC / replication** | **Datastream**, **Database Migration Service** | Move/replicate operational data |

Prefer **asynchronous, loosely coupled** integration for resilience and independent scaling. Synchronous calls are simpler but couple availability and latency of services together.

## Cost optimization techniques

- **Right-size** with custom machine types; review utilization with recommendations.
- **Spot VMs** for fault-tolerant, interruptible batch (deepest discount).
- **Committed Use Discounts (CUDs)** for steady, predictable 24/7 baseload.
- **Autoscale to zero** (Cloud Run, MIGs) so idle time costs nothing.
- **Storage class lifecycle** (Standard → Archive) and delete obsolete data.
- **Match resilience to criticality** — don't over-provision DR/HA for low-value workloads.
- Use **Gemini Cloud Assist** and Billing/FinOps tooling to investigate cost spikes and surface savings.

The meta-rule: **align spend with business value**. Cheapest is not the goal; *appropriate* is.

## KPIs and ROI

A good KPI is **specific, measurable, time-bound, and outcome-oriented**.

- Weak: "better performance."
- Strong: "Reduce p95 checkout latency from 1,200 ms to under 500 ms within 90 days of cutover."

**ROI** = (benefit − cost) / cost. Benefits include reduced TCO, faster time-to-market, higher availability (fewer outage losses), and engineering productivity. Define KPIs *before* the project so success is verifiable and the business case is honest.

## Cloud-first and future-proofing

- **Prefer managed/serverless** services to reduce operational toil (buy/repurchase over build for commodities).
- **Design for portability and change**: containers, IaC (Terraform/Config Connector), clear service boundaries.
- **Avoid premature lock-in trade-offs** consciously — managed services trade some portability for speed; document the decision.
- **Build in observability and automation** from day one (operational excellence).
- **Plan for growth**: elastic scaling, global load balancing, and data services that scale (Spanner, Bigtable, BigQuery) so the design survives 10x without a rewrite.

## Modern AI-era building blocks (2026 naming)

Be aware of current naming: **Gemini Cloud Assist** (console/CLI assistant), **Model Garden** (model catalog), **Model Armor** (GenAI safety/security filtering), and **AI Hypercomputer** (integrated TPU/GPU supercomputing stack). The agent/ML platform formerly branded Vertex AI is being renamed the **Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform**. Recognizing these helps you place AI workloads correctly during design.
